values.goal: Materialize all currently valid retained v0.91.8 terminal receipts into reviewed tracked projections without coercing unsafe exceptions.
values.required_outcome: The reviewed aggregate branch records receipt-identical terminal projections for every eligible issue and preserves a truthful blocked boundary for excluded cases.
declared_scope: Typed reconciliation of valid retained terminal receipts
Tracked issue index, six-card, audit, and retained-artifact projections
Focused receipt equality, doctor, path, and diff validation
Independent aggregate review and governed publication
authority_boundary: Issue #5746 owns only its lifecycle bundle and the exact included terminal projection directories
Excluded issue records and product implementation are not changed
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
No manual card or receipt edits
